definitions.clamped_hit_fraction: min(1, cached_tokens / expected_reusable_prefix_tokens) computed per request before aggregation
definitions.full_trace_wall_clock: sum of client elapsed_ms over every measured request in one formal repeat, including pressure fill and replay
definitions.prefetch_baseline: S4 hierarchical with prefetch mode p0; the Phase 5 prefetch matrix has no LRU arm, so P0 is the only valid control
definitions.s2_naming: S2 is a Belady-style next-request-ordinal oracle over the recorded trace; it is not a variable-size offline optimum
definitions.sample_independence: requests inside one trace are not independent experiments; per-restart and per-repeat values are reported separately
definitions.variable_size_offline_optimum: declared a Phase 7 deliverable; not computed here
